description: This file contains unit tests for the IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer class, verifying its behavior in enforcing length restrictions on index content in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer, testing length enforcement logic

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer instance before each test

methods.name: newInstanceWithNullThingIdFails
methods.description: Tests that creating an enforcer instance with null thing ID throws NullPointerException

methods.name: newInstanceWithEmptyThingIdFails
methods.description: Tests that creating an enforcer instance with empty thing ID throws IllegalArgumentException

methods.name: enforceRestrictionsOnViolation
methods.description: Verifies that values exceeding the maximum length are truncated appropriately

methods.name: doNotTruncateWithoutViolation
methods.description: Ensures that values within limits are not truncated

methods.name: giveUpIfKeyIsTooLong
methods.description: Checks that enforcement gives up when the key itself exceeds permissible length
